fullText.simplified:
机会

    时间慢慢过去，冬天到了。
    一天，有个北方人给孙坚写了信，他要孙坚去荆州打刘表。写信的人叫元树，以前帮过孙坚，也很相信孙坚。元树和他的哥哥元少是北方非常有名的人，也是国家非常重要的人，他们说的话，大家都会听。
    看完信，孙坚笑了。江东人不会忘记那些被刘表杀死的人，孙坚更不会忘，他一直在等一个机会，一个杀刘表的机会。现在机会来了，孙坚可以放心地去荆州打刘表了。因为有了元树的信，孙坚不用担心其他人怎么说了，也不用担心刘表找人帮忙了，现在没有人会帮刘表了。
    江东和荆州中间有一条很大的河。这个冬天的天气一直不好，非常冷，大家都不想出门，河上的船很少。
    这几个月，刘表在荆州过得很安静。虽然他很少出门，但也知道河那边的孙坚一定会打过来。他不知道孙坚什么时候来，就让助手们每天在河边看着。如果看到江东的船了，就马上把他们打回去。
    这一天下午，天气很不好，天很黑。
    刘表的助手突然看到河上有几条船，但是天太黑，他们看不清楚船上的人，也不知道那是不是江东军队的船。刘表也到河边看了看，他也看不清楚，就对助手说：“等船离得近了，你们就放箭，不要让船开过来。”
fullText.traditional:
機會

    時間慢慢過去，冬天到了。
    一天，有個北方人給孫堅寫了信，他要孫堅去荊州打劉表。寫信的人叫元樹，以前幫過孫堅，也很相信孫堅。元樹和他的哥哥元少是北方非常有名的人，也是國家非常重要的人，他們說的話，大家都會聽。
    看完信，孫堅笑了。江東人不會忘記那些被劉表殺死的人，孫堅更不會忘，他一直在等一個機會，一個殺劉表的機會。現在機會來了，孫堅可以放心地去荊州打劉表了。因為有了元樹的信，孫堅不用擔心其他人怎麼說了，也不用擔心劉表找人幫忙了，現在沒有人會幫劉表了。
    江東和荊州中間有一條很大的河。這個冬天的天氣一直不好，非常冷，大家都不想出門，河上的船很少。
    這幾個月，劉表在荊州過得很安靜。雖然他很少出門，但也知道河那邊的孫堅一定會打過來。他不知道孫堅什麼時候來，就讓助手們每天在河邊看著。如果看到江東的船了，就馬上把他們打回去。
    這一天下午，天氣很不好，天很黑。
    劉表的助手突然看到河上有幾條船，但是天太黑，他們看不清楚船上的人，也不知道那是不是江東軍隊的船。劉表也到河邊看了看，他也看不清楚，就對助手說：“等船離得近了，你們就放箭，不要讓船開過來。”

sentences.simplified: 时间慢慢过去，冬天到了。
sentences.traditional: 時間慢慢過去，冬天到了。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān màn man guò qù dōng tiān dào le
sentences.english: Slowly, time passed, and winter arrived.

sentences.simplified: 一天，有个北方人给孙坚写了信，他要孙坚去荆州打刘表。
sentences.traditional: 一天，有個北方人給孫堅寫了信，他要孫堅去荊州打劉表。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān yǒu ge běi fāng rén gěi sūn jiān xiě le xìn tā yào sūn jiān qù jīng zhōu dǎ liú biǎo
sentences.english: One day, someone from the north wrote a letter to Sun Jian. He wanted Sun Jian to go to Jingzhou and fight Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 写信的人叫元树，以前帮过孙坚，也很相信孙坚。
sentences.traditional: 寫信的人叫元樹，以前幫過孫堅，也很相信孫堅。
sentences.pinyin: xiě xìn de rén jiào yuán shù yǐ qián bāng guò sūn jiān yě hěn xiāng xìn sūn jiān
sentences.english: The person who wrote the letter was Yuan Shu. He had helped Sun Jian in the past and trusted him.

sentences.simplified: 元树和他的哥哥元少是北方非常有名的人，
sentences.traditional: 元樹和他的哥哥元少是北方非常有名的人，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù hé tā de gē ge yuán shào shì běi fāng fēi cháng yǒu míng de rén
sentences.english: Yuan Shu and his older brother Yuan Shao were very famous in the north.

sentences.simplified: 也是国家非常重要的人，他们说的话，大家都会听。
sentences.traditional: 也是國家非常重要的人，他們說的話，大家都會聽。
sentences.pinyin: yě shì guó jiā fēi cháng zhòng yào de rén tā men shuō de huà dà jiā dōu huì tīng
sentences.english: They were also very important people in the country. Everyone listened to what they had to say.

sentences.simplified: 看完信，孙坚笑了。江东人不会忘记那些被刘表杀死的人，
sentences.traditional: 看完信，孫堅笑了。江東人不會忘記那些被劉表殺死的人，
sentences.pinyin: kàn wán xìn sūn jiān xiào le jiāng dōng rén bú huì wàng jì nà xiē bèi liú biǎo shā sǐ de rén
sentences.english: After reading the letter, Sun Jian smiled. People from Jiangdong would not forget those who were killed by Liu Bao.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚更不会忘，他一直在等一个机会，一个杀刘表的机会。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅更不會忘，他一直在等一個機會，一個殺劉表的機會。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān gèng bú huì wàng tā yì zhí zài děng yí ge jī huì yí ge shā liú biǎo de jī huì
sentences.english: Sun Jian would also not forget. He was waiting for an opportunity, an opportunity to kill Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 现在机会来了，孙坚可以放心地去荆州打刘表了。
sentences.traditional: 現在機會來了，孫堅可以放心地去荊州打劉表了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jī huì lái le sūn jiān kě yǐ fàng xīn de qù jīng zhōu dǎ liú biǎo le
sentences.english: Now the opportunity had come. Sun Jian could go to Jingzhou to fight Liu Biao without worry.

sentences.simplified: 因为有了元树的信，孙坚不用担心其他人怎么说了，
sentences.traditional: 因為有了元樹的信，孫堅不用擔心其他人怎麼說了，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi yǒu le yuán shù de xìn sūn jiān bú yòng dān xīn qí tā rén zěn me shuō le
sentences.english: Because with Yuan Shu’s letter, Sun Jian didn’t have to worry about what other people would say.

sentences.simplified: 也不用担心刘表找人帮忙了，现在没有人会帮刘表了。
sentences.traditional: 也不用擔心劉表找人幫忙了，現在沒有人會幫劉表了。
sentences.pinyin: yě bú yòng dān xīn liú biǎo zhǎo rén bāng máng le xiàn zài méi yǒu rén huì bāng liú biǎo le
sentences.english: He also didn’t have to worry about Liu Biao getting help from other people because no one would help Liu Biao anymore.

sentences.simplified: 江东和荆州中间有一条很大的河。
sentences.traditional: 江東和荊州中間有一條很大的河。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng hé jīng zhōu zhōng jiān yǒu yì tiáo hěn dà de hé
sentences.english: There was a big river between Jiangdong and Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 这个冬天的天气一直不好，非常冷，大家都不想出门，河上的船很少。
sentences.traditional: 這個冬天的天氣一直不好，非常冷，大家都不想出門，河上的船很少。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dōng tiān de tiān qì yì zhí bù hǎo fēi cháng lěng dà jiā dōu bù xiǎng chū mén hé shang de chuán hěn shǎo
sentences.english: The weather had been bad for the entire winter. It was very cold, and no one wanted to go out. There were very few boats on the river.

sentences.simplified: 这几个月，刘表在荆州过得很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這幾個月，劉表在荊州過得很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jǐ ge yuè liú biǎo zài jīng zhōu guò de hěn ān jìng
sentences.english: Liu Biao had lived a very quiet life in Jingzhou for the past few months.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他很少出门，但也知道河那边的孙坚一定会打过来。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他很少出門，但也知道河那邊的孫堅一定會打過來。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā hěn shǎo chū mén dàn yě zhī dào hé nà biān de sūn jiān yí dìng huì dǎ guò lái
sentences.english: Even though he rarely went out, he knew that Sun Jian, on the other side of the river, would definitely come over to fight.

sentences.simplified: 他不知道孙坚什么时候来，就让助手们每天在河边看着。
sentences.traditional: 他不知道孫堅什麼時候來，就讓助手們每天在河邊看著。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù zhī dào sūn jiān shén me shí hou lái jiù ràng zhù shǒu men měi tiān zài hé biān kān zhe
sentences.english: He didn’t know when Sun Jian would come, so he had his assistants watch from the river every day.

sentences.simplified: 如果看到江东的船了，就马上把他们打回去。
sentences.traditional: 如果看到江東的船了，就馬上把他們打回去。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ kàn dào jiāng dōng de chuán le jiù mǎ shàng bǎ tā men dǎ huí qu
sentences.english: If they saw boats from Jiangdong, they were to immediately repel them.

sentences.simplified: 这一天下午，天气很不好，天很黑。
sentences.traditional: 這一天下午，天氣很不好，天很黑。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì tiān xià wǔ tiān qì hěn bù hǎo tiān hěn hēi
sentences.english: That afternoon, the weather was very bad, and the sky was very dark.

sentences.simplified: 刘表的助手突然看到河上有几条船，
sentences.traditional: 劉表的助手突然看到河上有幾條船，
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo de zhù shǒu tū rán kàn dào hé shang yǒu jǐ tiáo chuán
sentences.english: Liu Biao’s assistants suddenly saw several boats on the river.

sentences.simplified: 但是天太黑，他们看不清楚船上的人，也不知道那是不是江东军队的船。
sentences.traditional: 但是天太黑，他們看不清楚船上的人，也不知道那是不是江東軍隊的船。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tiān tài hēi tā men kàn bù qīng chu chuán shang de rén yě bù zhī dào nà shì bú shì jiāng dōng jūn duì de chuán
sentences.english: But it was so dark that they could not see the people on the boats clearly, and they did not know if the boats belonged to Jiangdong’s army.

sentences.simplified: 刘表也到河边看了看，他也看不清楚，
sentences.traditional: 劉表也到河邊看了看，他也看不清楚，
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo yě dào hé biān kàn le kàn tā yě kàn bù qīng chu
sentences.english: Liu Biao also went to the river to take a look, and he couldn’t see clearly either.

sentences.simplified: 就对助手说：“等船离得近了，你们就放箭，不要让船开过来。”
sentences.traditional: 就對助手說：“等船離得近了，你們就放箭，不要讓船開過來。”
sentences.pinyin: jiù duì zhù shǒu shuō děng chuán lí de jìn le nǐ men jiù fàng jiàn bú yào ràng chuán kāi guò lái
sentences.english: He told his assistants, “When the boats get closer, fire arrows and do not let them come over.”

sentence_translations: Opportunity
Slowly, time passed, and winter arrived.
One day, someone from the north wrote a letter to Sun Jian. He wanted Sun Jian to go to Jingzhou and fight Liu Biao.
The person who wrote the letter was Yuan Shu. He had helped Sun Jian in the past and trusted him.
Yuan Shu and his older brother Yuan Shao were very famous in the north.
They were also very important people in the country. Everyone listened to what they had to say.
After reading the letter, Sun Jian smiled. People from Jiangdong would not forget those who were killed by Liu Bao.
Sun Jian would also not forget. He was waiting for an opportunity, an opportunity to kill Liu Biao.
Now the opportunity had come. Sun Jian could go to Jingzhou to fight Liu Biao without worry.
Because with Yuan Shu’s letter, Sun Jian didn’t have to worry about what other people would say.
He also didn’t have to worry about Liu Biao getting help from other people because no one would help Liu Biao anymore.
There was a big river between Jiangdong and Jingzhou.
The weather had been bad for the entire winter. It was very cold, and no one wanted to go out. There were very few boats on the river.
Liu Biao had lived a very quiet life in Jingzhou for the past few months.
Even though he rarely went out, he knew that Sun Jian, on the other side of the river, would definitely come over to fight.
He didn’t know when Sun Jian would come, so he had his assistants watch from the river every day.
If they saw boats from Jiangdong, they were to immediately repel them.
That afternoon, the weather was very bad, and the sky was very dark.
Liu Biao’s assistants suddenly saw several boats on the river.
But it was so dark that they could not see the people on the boats clearly, and they did not know if the boats belonged to Jiangdong’s army.
Liu Biao also went to the river to take a look, and he couldn’t see clearly either.
He told his assistants, “When the boats get closer, fire arrows and do not let them come over.”
